intent.problem: PR #439 passed the complete local suite but Hosted template-smoke injected AI_BASE_COMMIT for the outer template Work Item. The real installer inherited that value while generating the temporary adopter status, so the adopter validator tried to resolve the template parent commit in the adopter repository and rolled back. Earlier nested-Make isolation did not cover direct installer status subprocesses.
constraints: Do not modify the archived predecessor evidence or merge superseded PR #439.
Do not bypass adopter baseCommit validation or installer rollback.
Use the real installer and the existing Japanese lifecycle fixture as executable evidence.
Filter all relevant Work Item and recursive Make context, not only AI_BASE_COMMIT.
Complete replacement PR, merge, closure, and branch cleanup before continuing JA-DOC-001.
intent.rationale: A shared installer subprocess environment derived from the established core isolation policy removes the ambient authority leak at the production boundary and a hosted-equivalent regression prevents recurrence.
